meta.promptText: India mein men ke liye konse brand ki formal shirts kharidni chahiye?

response.text:
India mein men ke liye formal shirts ke liye kai behtareen brands available hain, jo apni quality, fit aur fabric ke liye jaane jaate hain. Aapki budget aur requirement ke hisaab se yeh rahi top brands ki list:

---

### 1. Premium & Luxury Brands (Corporate & Special Occasions)

Agar aapko premium fabric aur sharp corporate look chahiye, toh yeh brands best hain:

* **Van Heusen:** India ke sabse popular formal shirt brands mein se ek hai. Inki shirts ka fabric durable hota hai aur wrinkle-resistant options bhi mil jaate hain.
* **Louis Philippe:** Yeh brand apni premium class aur sophisticated look ke liye jaana jaata hai. Boardroom meetings aur formal events ke liye yeh ek dam perfect hain.
* **Arrow:** America ka yeh purana brand apne classic fit, comfort aur premium cotton shirts ke liye famous hai.

---

### 2. Mid-Range & Best Value for Money (Daily Office Wear)

Agar aapko daily wear ke liye comfortable aur budget-friendly options chahiye:

* **Peter England:** Yeh India ka sabse trusted aur pocket-friendly formal brand hai. College graduates ya freshers ke liye aur daily office wear ke liye yeh best choice hai.
* **Park Avenue:** Raymond group ka yeh brand Indian weather ke hisaab se comfortable fabrics aur classic colours mein acchi variety deta hai.
* **Allen Solly:** Agar aap thoda modern, smart-casual ya vibrant formal look chahte hain (jaise pastel shades ya subtle checks), toh Allen Solly ek acha option hai.

---

### 3. Fab/Traditional & Pure Cotton Specialist

* **Raymond:** Custom tailoring ya ready-made pure cotton aur linen formal shirts ke liye Raymond ka koi mukabla nahi hai. Inka fabric skin-friendly aur long-lasting hota hai.

---

### Quick Buying Tips (Khareedte Waqt Kya Dhyan Rakhein):

* **Fit:** Hamesha apni body type ke hisaab se **Slim Fit** ya **Regular Fit** choose karein. Formal shirts mein shoulder seam theek jagah par honi chahiye.
* **Fabric:** Agar garmi ke liye chahiye, toh **100% Cotton** ya cotton-blend shirts lein taaki pasina absorb ho sake aur comfort rahe.
* **Colours:** Shuruaat mein **White, Light Blue, aur Light Grey** jaise classic colours se shuru karein, jo har trousers ke saath match ho sakein.
